responsibility: This header declares the core fixed-buffer string manipulation API for the mc-boot runtime. It exports procedures for concatenation, ordering and equality tests, length calculation, bounded copying, substring detection, and white-prefix removal over Modula-2/C-style character arrays, defining the public low-level string toolkit used throughout the module.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface half of the GStrLib pair, declaring the low-level string utility entry points for clients, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrLib.cc provides the actual string-manipulation routines.
